description: L-01 (Case 0: a league table and a report card, pages/learn/case-zero.qmd): counts of KRW's two published single-criterion cards that the case registry does not hold, computed in the browser engine from the released cards (data/released/case-krw.json tables.reports): the pairs a card withholds (pairs that share a grade, counted as the pairs that a strict order consistent with the card orders but the card does not: misorderedPairs of strictOrder(card, ascending) against the card), the number of grades, the size of the largest grade and the pairs inside it (disclosure, pairCount). Also the released values of a few named rows the widget shows at its presets (the firm with the largest race estimate, the firm with the largest race posterior mean, the firm with the largest gender estimate, the firms at positions 40 and 41 of the race league table), each read from the released table through the mean of a one-state law (rankSummaries), and their ranks (strictOrder). Row indices are 0-based positions in the released table, which keeps KRW's firm order. Step 5.14 fixes add State Farm (row 30: the smallest race estimate and the largest race SE, whose posterior mean is positive), the smallest and largest race SE (rows 15 and 30), and the grade of the firm in second place by race estimate (row 36, Nationwide) with the firms that share it.
